implementation: independent solver sharing no relation, Kronecker or barcode code with the reference: integer box maps, iterative Kosaraju SCCs, window relations as projections of zigzag section spaces glued by pullbacks (no early exit), Kronecker invariants from pencil kernel dimensions over F2[s]/(q) and polynomial-kernel ranks, barcodes from per-start generalized-rank sweeps; Morse-graph barcodes from a right-to-left sweep of domain and kernel flags
